<!-- definizione-1: body_md -->
We say that a Hodge--K\"ahler manifold ${\cal M}$ is {\bf special K\"ahler} if there exists a bundle ${\cal H}$ of the type described above
such that for some section $\Omega \, \in \, \Gamma({\cal H},{\cal M})$ the K\"ahler two form is given by ($\alpha ,\beta =1,\ldots ,n$)
\begin{equation}
\mathrm{K}= {{\rm i}\over{2}}
 \partial \bar \partial \, \mbox{\rm log} \, \left ({\rm i}\langle \Omega \,
 \vert \, \bar \Omega
\rangle \right )=\frac{i}{2}\,g_{\alpha  \beta ^*}\,dz^\alpha \wedge {\rm d}\bar{z}^{\beta ^*}  \label{compati1}
\end{equation}
<!-- end definizione-1 -->
